cohort: The study included 1025 infants from the CHILD Cohort Study, with parent-reported ASM use at ages 3, 6, and 12 months, and BMI-z scores calculated at age 5 years.
finding: H2RA use in infants was indirectly associated with higher 5-year BMI-z scores, mediated through increased C. difficile colonisation at 3 months.
followup_time: Up to 5 years (from infancy to age 5 years)
